name: Question 14
problem:
A man starts a business, stocking a pond with $100$ catfish. After $t$ weeks, the birth and death rates of catfish in the pond are given by the functions $45+5t$ and $1+t,$ respectively.

Given that the rate at which catfish are sold is $30$ per week, identify the expression that gives the number $C(t)$ of catfish in the pond at any time $t>0.$

A man starts a business, stocking a pond with 100 catfish. After t weeks, the birth and death rates of catfish in the pond are given by the functions 45+5t and 1+t, respectively.

a
C(t)=100+t2+18t
b
C(t)=10+2t2−14t
c
C(t)=94+4t2+28t
d
C(t)=100+2t2+14t
e
C(t)=86+2t2+14t
